footprint_target_cm.source: BP_PickupXP PickupMesh /Engine/BasicShapes/Cube (100 cm) x scale 0.3; big block scale 1.8 (root 0.54) applied in game, not baked

warnings: M_XPChipBig_core is emissive in Blender (strength 4, #FF26BF): the FBX does not carry emission, the Unreal material sets the glow (MI_PickupXPBig)

fidelity.camera: ortho 50 cm, azimuth 45 (board corner toward viewer), elevation 35, light-grey world, sun 3.0; source estimated at about 35 deg elevation, corner toward viewer

C1.evidence: Slab 30 x 30 x 3.4 cm (11 %), four tiles with 0.3 cm seams visible as steps down to the base slab.

C2.evidence: Square body 19 cm (63 %), top 9.5 cm (rise 6.1 cm = 20 %), slope toward the core visible on the back faces; but the 4 corner notches are small raised dark blocks, not cuts, so they read only roughly.

C3.evidence: Core 11.6 cm (39 %) is a two-step faceted pyramid in a square recess below the rim, steps visible in the render; magenta.

C4.evidence: 3 light-grey L legs with a chamfered elbow and foot on each of the +x and -y sides, both facing the viewer; less curved than the source (angular elbow only).

C5.evidence: 4 hexagonal bolts 3.5 cm across (about 11 %), 1.9 cm high, clearly raised at the corners.

C6.evidence: 4 light-grey traces with right-angle bends (thin raised strips), 2 larger box components on opposite sides (-x and +x) and 1 smaller on +y; traces are thinner and shorter than in the source.

C7.evidence: Board and casing gunmetal, legs, bolts, traces light grey, core magenta #FF26BF, no cyan.

C8.evidence: 622 tris (max 1000), 30 x 30 x 9.7 cm, pivot bottom centre, flat shading, UV0 and LightMap UV1 checks pass.

open_failures: C2 corner notches are raised dark blocks, not real notches
